claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 are priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
claims.excerpt: they’re available at a lower price: $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 generate outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1.
claims.excerpt: They generate outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1

claims.claim_text: Anthropic reports that Fable 5.2 scores 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0 at Xhigh effort, the highest score of any released model it has tested.
claims.excerpt: At Xhigh effort, Fable 5.2 reaches 49.1%, the highest score of any released model we’ve tested.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says a team of 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents fully formalized Fermat’s Last Theorem in Lean in 30 hours with minimal human intervention.
claims.excerpt: By contrast, a team of 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents fully formalized the theorem in just 30 hours, with minimal human intervention.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 solved two open problems in theoretical physics concerning black holes.
claims.excerpt: Claude Fable 5.2 solved two open problems in theoretical physics.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 designed three working electronic devices from scratch during prerelease testing.
claims.excerpt: designed three working electronic devices from scratch

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Fable 5.2 has about 55% fewer safeguard blocks than Fable 5.1 in early testing.
claims.excerpt: we observed about 55% fewer blocks with Fable 5.2 compared with Fable 5.1

claims.claim_text: Anthropic reports that on its internal CVE Rediscovery evaluation, Claude Mythos 5.2 found 10.2% more vulnerabilities than Claude Opus 5.5 and 14.4% more than Claude Mythos 5.1.
claims.excerpt: found 10.2% more vulnerabilities than Claude Opus 5.5 and 14.4% more than Claude Mythos 5.1.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 is available today on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
claims.excerpt: Claude Fable 5.2 is available today on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says it assessed the risk of Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 behaving in unsafe ways in high-stakes situations as low.
claims.excerpt: we’ve assessed the risk of these models behaving in unsafe ways in high-stakes situations to be low
